meta.themes: Light (primary), Dark, Outdoor (high contrast for direct sunlight)

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen and the web portal canvas. White in Outdoor.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, table bodies, form fields. The default ground for text. White in Outdoor.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a surface: table headers, the photo strip tray, read-only values, skeletons. Kept as a light stone in Outdoor, where text on it still reaches 8:1.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, bottom sheets and dialogs; always paired with a shadow token.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Snackbars and tooltips. Text on it is text-inverse.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows, card outlines, dividers. Never the only boundary of a control. In Outdoor it reaches 3.9:1 on every ground, so cards and rows are set apart by line, not shade.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox and radio outlines. 3.6:1 on surface in Light and Dark; 9.4:1 or more in Outdoor, where inputs draw it 2px wide.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface, surface-sunken and surface-raised (14.8:1 or more).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: field help, meta lines, column headers. 6.1:1 or more on every surface; 10:1 or more in Outdoor.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders and timestamps. 4.7:1 or more on every surface; 8:1 or more in Outdoor. Never for values a user must act on.

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse. In Outdoor, also the text on inverted sync banners, whose fill is a status -fg (7:1 or more).

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only (exempt from contrast). Pair with a disabled cursor and no hover.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Tenant brand accent (product default 'Jamun'). Primary buttons, selected tab, active nav, links, the live-user dot on maps. Overridden per tenant at runtime; see Tenant theming.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for accent.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Selected row, selected chip and active nav item background.

tokens.name: accent-subtle-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-subtle (10.6:1 light, 9.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. Dark text in Dark because the accent lightens; white in Outdoor, where the accent stays dark enough for 7:1.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline with a 2px offset on every focusable control. Tenant accents pass AA on white (spec 5.1), so the ring clears 3:1 on every light surface. Drawn 3px wide in Outdoor.

tokens.name: success-fg
tokens.usage: Status text and icon on success-bg or surface. Approved, accepted, present, completed, fulfilled. 7:1 or more on every ground in Outdoor.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Status badge and banner fill. Approved, accepted, present, completed, fulfilled. White in Outdoor, where badges and pills are outlined instead of tinted.

tokens.name: success-border
tokens.usage: Outline for success badges and banners (the label carries meaning). In Outdoor it aliases the -fg colour, so the outline itself reaches 7:1.

tokens.name: success-solid
tokens.usage: Dots, map markers, chart series and progress fills for success. 3:1 or more on surface; never set text on it. 4.6:1 or more in Outdoor.

tokens.name: pending-fg
tokens.usage: Status text and icon on pending-bg or surface. Pending: submitted and waiting for the first decision, draft targets, queued uploads. 7:1 or more on every ground in Outdoor. Outdoor sync banners use it as their fill under text-inverse.

tokens.name: pending-bg
tokens.usage: Status badge and banner fill. Pending: submitted and waiting for the first decision, draft targets, queued uploads. White in Outdoor, where badges and pills are outlined instead of tinted.

tokens.name: pending-border
tokens.usage: Outline for pending badges and banners (the label carries meaning). In Outdoor it aliases the -fg colour, so the outline itself reaches 7:1.

tokens.name: pending-solid
tokens.usage: Dots, map markers, chart series and progress fills for pending. 3:1 or more on surface; never set text on it. 4.6:1 or more in Outdoor.

tokens.name: waiting-fg
tokens.usage: Status text and icon on waiting-bg or surface. Waiting at a later approval step, partially accepted, partially fulfilled, outside geofence (advisory). 7:1 or more on every ground in Outdoor.

tokens.name: waiting-bg
tokens.usage: Status badge and banner fill. Waiting at a later approval step, partially accepted, partially fulfilled, outside geofence (advisory). White in Outdoor, where badges and pills are outlined instead of tinted.

tokens.name: waiting-border
tokens.usage: Outline for waiting badges and banners (the label carries meaning). In Outdoor it aliases the -fg colour, so the outline itself reaches 7:1.

tokens.name: waiting-solid
tokens.usage: Dots, map markers, chart series and progress fills for waiting. 3:1 or more on surface; never set text on it. 4.6:1 or more in Outdoor.

tokens.name: info-fg
tokens.usage: Status text and icon on info-bg or surface. Planned and visited plan items; informational notices; links inside notices. 7:1 or more on every ground in Outdoor. Outdoor sync banners use it as their fill under text-inverse.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Status badge and banner fill. Planned and visited plan items; informational notices; links inside notices. White in Outdoor, where badges and pills are outlined instead of tinted.

tokens.name: info-border
tokens.usage: Outline for info badges and banners (the label carries meaning). In Outdoor it aliases the -fg colour, so the outline itself reaches 7:1.

tokens.name: info-solid
tokens.usage: Dots, map markers, chart series and progress fills for info. 3:1 or more on surface; never set text on it. 4.6:1 or more in Outdoor.

tokens.name: danger-fg
tokens.usage: Status text and icon on danger-bg or surface. Rejected, absent, refused by server (parked), destructive actions, validation errors. 7:1 or more on every ground in Outdoor. Outdoor sync banners use it as their fill under text-inverse.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Status badge and banner fill. Rejected, absent, refused by server (parked), destructive actions, validation errors. White in Outdoor, where badges and pills are outlined instead of tinted.

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Outline for danger badges and banners (the label carries meaning). In Outdoor it aliases the -fg colour, so the outline itself reaches 7:1.

tokens.name: danger-solid
tokens.usage: Dots, map markers, chart series and progress fills for danger. 3:1 or more on surface; text on it only in on-danger (destructive buttons, count badges). 4.6:1 or more in Outdoor.

tokens.name: neutral-fg
tokens.usage: Status text and icon on neutral-bg or surface. Cancelled, inactive, missed-and-closed, auto-closed, discarded. 7:1 or more on every ground in Outdoor.

tokens.name: neutral-bg
tokens.usage: Status badge and banner fill. Cancelled, inactive, missed-and-closed, auto-closed, discarded. White in Outdoor, where badges and pills are outlined instead of tinted.

tokens.name: neutral-border
tokens.usage: Outline for neutral badges and banners (the label carries meaning). In Outdoor it aliases the -fg colour, so the outline itself reaches 7:1.

tokens.name: neutral-solid
tokens.usage: Dots, map markers, chart series and progress fills for neutral. 3:1 or more on surface; never set text on it. 4.6:1 or more in Outdoor.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger-solid fill: destructive buttons and count badges.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Categorical series 1 (ECharts palette order). Mix by form, by account type. Use status tokens instead when a series means a status.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Categorical series 2 (ECharts palette order). Mix by form, by account type. Use status tokens instead when a series means a status.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Categorical series 3 (ECharts palette order). Mix by form, by account type. Use status tokens instead when a series means a status.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Categorical series 4 (ECharts palette order). Mix by form, by account type. Use status tokens instead when a series means a status.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Categorical series 5 (ECharts palette order). Mix by form, by account type. Use status tokens instead when a series means a status. Darkened in Outdoor to 4.5:1 on white so thin lines survive glare.

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Categorical series 6 (ECharts palette order). Mix by form, by account type. Use status tokens instead when a series means a status.

tokens.name: chart-7
tokens.usage: Categorical series 7 (ECharts palette order). Mix by form, by account type. Use status tokens instead when a series means a status.

tokens.name: chart-8
tokens.usage: Categorical series 8 (ECharts palette order). Mix by form, by account type. Use status tokens instead when a series means a status.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and axis ticks. Stronger in Outdoor.

tokens.name: chart-target
tokens.usage: Target line on attainment charts: 1.5px dashed.

tokens.name: map-route
tokens.usage: Replay route polyline from fixes with accuracy of 100 m or better.

tokens.name: map-geofence
tokens.usage: Geofence ring around an account: stroke at 100%, fill at 12% opacity.

tokens.name: map-inside
tokens.usage: Visit marker inside the geofence.

tokens.name: map-outside
tokens.usage: Visit marker outside the geofence (advisory policy).

tokens.name: map-stale
tokens.usage: On-duty user whose last fix is older than 15 minutes. Pair with the age label.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs and bottom sheets.

families.sans: "Noto Sans", "Noto Sans Devanagari", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", "Noto Sans Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Home greeting on mobile; page titles on wide web layouts. One per screen.

styles.name: heading-xl
styles.usage: Web page title under the header; mobile full-screen titles (Visit, Form).

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Section titles, sheet titles, dialog titles.

styles.name: heading-md
styles.usage: Card titles, account names in lists, form section headings.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Saved on this phone. It will upload when you are back online.
styles.usage: Default body on mobile (comfortable density). Never smaller for running text on phones.

styles.name: body-md
styles.sample: Only approved activity counts toward your targets.
styles.usage: Default body on web (compact density); table cells.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Meta lines under titles, evidence timestamps, help text on web.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Figures as of 30 Sep from ERP
styles.usage: Chart axis labels, footnotes, dated-snapshot labels. Not for anything a user must act on.

styles.name: label-lg
styles.usage: Mobile buttons (48 px controls), bottom-sheet actions.

styles.name: label-md
styles.usage: Web buttons, form labels, tabs, nav items.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Status badges, flag chips, table column headers, bottom tab labels.

styles.name: metric-xl
styles.usage: KPI tile actual value. Always tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) in the tenant locale.

styles.name: metric-md
styles.usage: Attainment percent, cart total, shift on-duty time. Tabular figures.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Numbers in tables and line items, right-aligned, tabular figures.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Codes: user codes, SKUs, order numbers, error codes in the upload queue, API keys in settings.

spacing.note: 4 px base. Mobile pads screens with space-4, web with space-6.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: Flush joins.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Badge dot to label gap; hairline nudges.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside badges and chips; stacked meta lines.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label in buttons; gap between chips; table cell vertical padding (compact).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact web); gap between form fields' label and input group.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (mobile); mobile screen gutter; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sheet padding; gap between list cards on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Web page gutter; gap between dashboard tiles; section spacing inside cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top spacing above page titles on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Large empty states and onboarding.

size.note: Control heights per density. Comfortable (mobile) never goes under touch-min.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for anything tappable on mobile (spec 8.5). Pad small icons out to this.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact web: table row actions, filter chips, toolbar buttons.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Web default: buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Mobile default: buttons, inputs, list rows with one line.

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: Web table row height.

tokens.name: row-comfortable
tokens.usage: Mobile list rows with title and meta line.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in badges, chips, table cells.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons, inputs and web nav.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Mobile bottom tabs, app bar actions.

tokens.name: nav-web
tokens.usage: Web left navigation width (collapses to 64px).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum web content width; tables and maps may run full-bleed.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chart bars, progress tracks, focus outline corners on tight elements.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, flag chips, checkboxes, table row actions.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, tiles in the photo strip.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, KPI tiles, banners, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets (top corners only), dialogs on mobile.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Distance pill, avatars, status dots, segmented-progress caps.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards on bg when a border alone is too quiet (KPI tiles, review cards). None in Outdoor: the card border does the work.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, sticky table headers while scrolled. Outdoor adds a 1px ink ring so the edge holds in glare.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, bottom sheets, the map side panel. Outdoor adds a 2px ink ring.

tokens.name: z-base
tokens.usage: Page content.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table headers, the sync banner, the mobile bottom tab bar.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Menus, selects, comboboxes.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Dialogs and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Snackbars and toasts.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips, always on top.

breakpoint.note: Mobile app layouts are tested at 360 dp. Web is desktop-first but must not break at bp-md.

tokens.name: bp-xs
tokens.usage: Smallest supported phone width (spec 8.5).

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones and small tablets: two-column forms begin.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablet: web nav collapses to icons below this.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Laptop: review queue shows list and detail side by side.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Desktop: live map shows the user list and map together.

tokens.name: bp-2xl
tokens.usage: Wide: dashboards add a fourth KPI column.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls (with text-disabled labels).

tokens.name: opacity-geofence
tokens.usage: Geofence circle fill on maps.

tokens.name: opacity-stale
tokens.usage: Map markers and list rows for users whose last fix is stale.
